headline: Pukachu Chews You Buries Waffle House 161.7-54.75 as Meredith's Fan Club Leaves C.J. Stroud's 59.2 on the Bench
meme_brief: A team benches its quarterback for 59.2 points, starts a different quarterback instead, and still wins comfortably — the fantasy equivalent of leaving a winning lottery ticket in your other pants and finding out it didn't even matter.
recap:
There was no close game this week — the nearest thing was a 13.75-point decision, which doesn't clear the bar for a nail-biter, so the real story is the gap between the top and bottom of the league. Pukachu Chews You put up the week's biggest number, 161.7, in a 106.95-point demolition of Waffle House, who managed just 54.75. Jordan Love went off for 49.9 points to lead Pukachu, the top score among starters this week.

Meredith's Fan Club beat demon44 14.8 points, 106.6 to 91.8, but the real number from that game belongs to the bench: C.J. Stroud sat and scored 59.2 points while Patrick Mahomes started and managed 24.9, a 34.3-point gap that stands as the week's single worst lineup decision by a wide margin. mikelanta also left points on the table, sitting KC Concepcion's 19.8 behind Jalen Coker's 4.6 in a 60.4-point win over Dak to the Future that didn't need the extra points anyway. Joe Mama Angie Daddy beat Non Regulators 165.95-112.9 behind a 42.25-point game from Joe Burrow, while Screaming Eagles handled Broke Dak Mountain 133.75-86.9 with Drake Maye throwing for 33.25. Silverbacks edged Long Live King Henry 106.7-92.95 on the strength of Ja'Marr Chase's 27.5.
transaction_desk:
Nothing resembling a bidding war happened this week — every move logged was an uncontested pickup, mostly teams cycling defenses off bye weeks or matchups. mikelanta made three moves in sequence, adding the 49ers' defense, then churning through Audric Estime before dropping him the same week for DeMario Douglas, none of it costing any priority since mikelanta sits at the back of the order anyway. Dak to the Future added Keon Coleman for free, which has produced 3.2 points so far — not nothing, but not yet justifying a roster spot either.

The more interesting story is in the earlier pickups. Silverbacks has gotten 86.7 points from Aaron Rodgers since adding him in week 5 for zero priority. Joe Mama Angie Daddy's free pickup of Tre Tucker back in week 6 has quietly produced 53.5 cumulative points for nothing spent, which is the kind of value most of the league would kill for off waivers. None of this week's moves cost anything meaningful, so there's no bad-priority story to tell here — just a lot of defense streaming and bench churn.

standings_narrative:
The top of the bracket is settled for now: Joe Mama Angie Daddy (8-1), Non Regulators (6-3), and Pukachu Chews You (5-4) hold the three division crowns and the top three seeds by record. Screaming Eagles and Dak to the Future, both 5-4, take the next two spots on strength of record alone. The sixth and final seed goes not to the next-best record but to total points scored among everyone left outside the top five, and right now that's mikelanta at 4-5 — their 1,113.9 points keep them ahead of Long Live King Henry, who sits on the bubble at 3-6 despite outscoring several teams with winning records.

That leaves Broke Dak Mountain, Silverbacks, demon44, Meredith's Fan Club, and Waffle House all outside the picture as things stand. Broke Dak Mountain and Meredith's Fan Club, both 5-4, are the most dangerous of that group — one hot points week could easily flip the wildcard math, especially with mikelanta's cushion over Long Live King Henry thin enough to erase.
look_ahead: Next week, Non Regulators faces Broke Dak Mountain in a matchup between a 6-3 division leader and a 5-4 team still fighting for position outside the current playoff cutoff. Joe Mama Angie Daddy, the league's only one-loss team at 8-1, draws Waffle House at 1-8. Dak to the Future (5-4) and Long Live King Henry (3-6) meet with Dak currently holding the fifth seed and Long Live King Henry on the bubble. Silverbacks (4-5) and Screaming Eagles (5-4) face off, and Meredith's Fan Club (5-4) takes on Pukachu Chews You (5-4), the current third seed.
